summary.text: Bridger Bolinder is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 29, which covers parts of Juab, Millard and Tooele counties, and has served since 2023. He serves as House Majority Assistant Whip.

paragraphs.text: Bolinder graduated from Grantsville High School and afterward started several small businesses, including Bolinder Resources, a sand and gravel and mining company based in Tooele.
He sits on the House Health and Human Services Committee and the House Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment Committee.
He lives in Grantsville with his wife and four children.
